scope: Normal causal VLM decoder for unified human box, instance mask, COCO-17 pose, gender, and age; no Stage-1 specialist task head.
verified_literature_findings: LocLLM and PoseLLM show that a standard decoder-only LLM can emit keypoint coordinates with next-token cross-entropy, while jointly adapting the visual encoder and LLM with LoRA; their strongest COCO results use single-person crops or ground-truth boxes and are not directly comparable to full-image multi-person inference.
Text4Seg shows decoder-free segmentation through autoregressive text plus LoRA, and reports strong masks without SAM; optional SAM refinement improves boundaries but is not required.
HiMTok shows compact learned mask tokens can outperform boundary-point representations, but requires a separately trained mask tokenizer/detokenizer and hierarchical mask loss.
Text4Seg++ and Youtu-VL support compact coordinate or mask vocabularies and grounding-first dense generation, but both use substantially larger-scale training than this pilot.

The 2026 mechanistic analysis finds that adapters can drop fine spatial information and that LLM layers can recover semantic consistency but cannot reconstruct detail absent from the vision encoder; this supports training the visual path and preserving high-resolution inputs.

local_protocol_evidence.conclusion: For the present no-small COCO-UniHuman protocol, the fixed codec is not the active accuracy bottleneck; model generation and representation learning must be tested next.

selected_stage1_change.architecture: Replace v4 hidden-state pose/mask heads with the native tied Qwen LM head for all five tasks.
selected_stage1_change.serialization: Keep one deterministic box-first person slot; pose and segment follow the owner box, with loc1000 COCO-17 coordinates and contour64 masks.
selected_stage1_change.adaptation: Train LoRA across all Qwen Vision and Qwen LLM blocks, fully train the merger, and train only the newly added tied token rows outside those adapters.
selected_stage1_change.objective: Use active-task-balanced next-token CE; no BCE, Dice, OKS, regression, heatmap, SAM, or hidden-state mask loss.
selected_stage1_change.resolution: Use the same approximately one-megapixel native-aspect preprocessing for Stage-0, S1_INIT, and trained Stage-1 arms.
selected_stage1_change.evaluation: Only free generation is capability evidence; grammar-constrained generation is diagnostic. Rank each task with generated span log-probabilities, never self-reported confidence.

rejected_for_mainline_now: v4 dense pose and mask heads
SAM, Mask2Former, and LISA-style external mask decoding
HiMTok learned mask codec before contour64 fails a generated gate
full-parameter tuning before joint LoRA fails the admitted gates
using LocLLM/PoseLLM top-down AP as a directly comparable target
next_gate: Freeze Stage-0 and Stage-1 prompts, parsers, confidence, processor shapes, and the 32-image smoke manifest; then run S1_INIT_CODEC_0STEP before G1 overfit-64.
